name: Blood of the Wrathful
summary: Blood of the Wrathful is a potent demonic reagent taken from Zelemar the Wrathful deep within Ragefire Chasm. Blood Knights require this volatile ichor to temper and quench the signature weapon of their order, the blood-tempered ranseur.

sections.title: A Temper of Demonic Ichor
sections.body: When forging a blood-tempered ranseur, ordinary blacksmithing methods are insufficient to hold the volatile energies wielded by the Blood Knights. While common demonic blood possesses inherent power, the metal quenching process demands a far more concentrated reagent. Knight-Lord Bloodvalor explicitly instructs initiates to retrieve the blood of Zelemar the Wrathful, a demonic terror lurking in the volcanic crevices beneath Orgrimmar. Quenched in this foul fluid, the ranseur acquires its lethal edge and resilience.

faq.q: Where does Blood of the Wrathful come from?
aliases: who drops blood of the wrathful
where to get blood of wrathful
faq.answer: It is gathered from the corpse of Zelemar the Wrathful, an imposing demonic entity found lurking within the depths of Ragefire Chasm.

faq.q: Why is this specific demonic blood needed?
faq.answer: According to Knight-Lord Bloodvalor's research, the blood of ordinary lesser demons lacks the raw potency required for the quenching process. Only the concentrated, potent ichor of an intensely wrathful fiend can properly temper the polearm's specialized alloy.

faq.q: What is the blood used to forge?
aliases: what does blood of the wrathful make
faq.answer: It serves as the quenching agent used to temper the metal for a blood-tempered ranseur, the iconic polearm granted to newly recognized initiates of the Blood Knights.

angles.text: For Blood Knights undergoing the Path of the Adept, securing this vile fluid is a crucial rite of passage to temper their signature polearm.
Traditional quenching typically relies on water, brine, or oil, but tempering blood-forged alloys demands the concentrated supernatural heat found only in potent demonic blood.
